methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official /pricing page on 2026-06-14. Retool's pricing page geo-redirected to EUR; USD figures sourced from GetApp (getapp.com) and SoftwareAdvice, which both independently show Team=$10/seat/mo and Business=$50/seat/mo — consistent with EUR figures at current exchange rates. All prices reflect the smallest billable unit (one seat). Annual rates are the annualized monthly equivalent. monthlyUsd on per_seat plans = price for one seat. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers recorded as null. Non-telephony vertical: minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan.

vendors.name: Retool
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page retool.com/pricing geo-redirected to EUR on 2026-06-14. USD prices sourced from GetApp (getapp.com/content-management-software/a/retool/pricing/) and SoftwareAdvice (softwareadvice.com/construction/retool-profile/) which both report Team=$10/user/mo and Business=$50/user/mo. Retool's page distinguishes 'builder' and 'internal user' seats; third-party sources show a simplified single per-user figure. HIPAA not mentioned on pricing page or accessible security page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 5 users, 500 workflow runs/month, 250 AI credits/month. No annual billing required.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Per user/month. 20% savings with annual billing. 5,000 workflow runs/month, staging environment. EUR pricing page shows €9/builder/mo and €5/internal-user/mo; third-party USD sources consolidate to $10/user/mo.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per user/month. 20% savings with annual billing. Audit logging, rich permission controls, custom branding, portals. EUR pricing page shows €46/builder/mo and €14/internal-user/mo; third-party USD sources consolidate to $50/user/mo.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. Includes SAML/OIDC SSO, volume-based discounts, dedicated support.
